title: Lupoid Onychodystrophy
desc: Niacinamide plus tetracycline (or doxycycline/minocycline), vitamin E and essential fatty acids, escalating to pentoxifylline. Also covers plasma cell pododermatitis.

meds.name: Niacinamide
meds.desc: dosed by size band, not per kg
meds.chartNote: 250 mg BID under 10 kg; 500 mg BID over 10 kg.
meds.note: Given as a pair with tetracycline — neither is used alone for this condition. Niacinamide, not niacin.

meds.name: Tetracycline
meds.chartNote: 250 mg BID under 10 kg; 500 mg BID over 10 kg — the same size bands as niacinamide.
meds.note: Used here for its immunomodulating effect rather than as an antibiotic.

meds.name: Doxycycline
meds.note: 5 mg/kg SID or BID. Minocycline is equivalent to doxycycline here and can be swapped one for one.

meds.name: Omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids
meds.note: The published dose is 180 mg EPA per 5 kg per day, which is the 36 mg/kg/day calculated above. Safe upper limit is 370 mg/kg^0.75 per day — for most dogs the calculated dose sits well below that, but check in a very large dog.

meds.grp: If not improving at 4 to 6 weeks
meds.name: Pentoxifylline
meds.desc: added when the first-line pair is not enough
meds.note: 15 mg/kg BID, in 400 mg tablets. Add if there is no improvement after 4 to 6 weeks. If it then improves, wean off the doxycycline, and possibly off the niacinamide too.

meds.name: Doxycycline
meds.desc: a different condition with a different course length
freqs: twice daily for at least 30 days, then once daily for a further 30–60 days
meds.note: 5 mg/kg BID for at least 30 days, then drop to once daily for maintenance for another 30 to 60 days. This disease tends to relapse.

notes.Preferred protocol: Niacinamide plus tetracycline, both dosed by size band — 250 mg BID under 10 kg, 500 mg BID over 10 kg — with vitamin E and essential fatty acids alongside.
notes.Substituting the tetracycline: Doxycycline 5 mg/kg SID or BID can replace tetracycline; minocycline is equivalent to doxycycline.
notes.Escalation: If there is no improvement after 4 to 6 weeks, add pentoxifylline 15 mg/kg BID. If things then improve, wean off the doxycycline, with or without weaning off the niacinamide.
notes.Fatty acid ceiling: 180 mg EPA per 5 kg per day. The safe upper limit is 370 mg/kg^0.75 per day.
notes.Plasma cell pododermatitis: A separate condition: doxycycline 5 mg/kg BID for at least 30 days, then once daily for maintenance for a further 30–60 days. It tends to relapse.

dischargeBlocks.title: What is happening to the nails
dischargeBlocks.text:
{name}'s immune system is attacking the nail beds. The nails become brittle, split, and lift away — which is painful, and why {name} may have been licking at the feet.

The medications calm that immune reaction. They do not glue the nails back on: the damaged nails have to grow out, and that takes months.

dischargeBlocks.title: How long this takes
dischargeBlocks.text:
Please expect to wait.

- The first sign of improvement is usually new, healthy nail growing in at the base — not the old nails looking better.
- We reassess at 4 to 6 weeks. If there is no change by then we add another medication.
- Most dogs stay on treatment for many months, and some stay on a reduced dose long term.

Stopping early because nothing seems to be happening is the commonest reason this fails.

dischargeBlocks.title: Looking after the feet
dischargeBlocks.text:
- Keep the nails trimmed short — ask us to show you how short is right.
- Loose or lifting nails are painful; do not pull them, and let us remove any that need it.
- Keep the feet clean and dry.
- Call us if a foot becomes swollen, smelly, or discharging — that usually means infection on top.

dischargeBlocks.title: About the medication
dischargeBlocks.text:
Several of these are given twice a day, and consistency matters more than the exact time.

Give them with food. Call us before stopping or changing anything, even if {name} seems better.

dischargeBlocks.title: Follow up
dischargeBlocks.text: Please book a recheck at 4 to 6 weeks so we can see whether new nail is growing in and decide whether to add anything.
